name: external_bobbuilder_ac
description: External patch/aimbot (AssaultCubeExternalBobBuilder) against ac_client.exe. External validator; no self-injection. Operator-driven: the runner enters external-attacker mode, prints the AC PID, and waits for the operator to launch AssaultCubeAimbot.exe from a separate shell, let it operate against AC for ~30 seconds, close it, then press Enter in the runner shell to trigger cooldown.

extra.operator_commands: In a second PowerShell, after the runner prints the target PID, launch: & 'External_Cheats\AC\AssaultCubeExternalBobBuilder\Release\AssaultCubeAimbot.exe'  ; interact for ~30s; close the overlay window; return to the runner shell and press Enter.
extra.notes: No manipulation section on purpose — BobBuilder is an ImGui overlay that stays running until closed, so the runner cannot Start-Process -Wait on it. External-attacker mode is the correct model.
